title: Native Windows Pi system bootstrap
intent: Converge a Windows x64 or ARM64 workstation onto the exact tracked standalone Pi release under AgentSwitchboard machine ownership without requiring npm, Node.js, or a user-local package-manager runtime.

runtime.pathPrecedence: AgentSwitchboard bin is first among Machine PATH entries

ascertainBeforeMutation: tracked architecture-specific release asset URL and SHA-256

windowsShell.purpose: Pi's model-facing bash tool on Windows

requiredApplyProof: tracked archive digest equals downloaded digest
staged pi.exe reports exact tracked version
managed runtime manifest binds exact version and digest
canonical managed launcher reports exact tracked version

scopeBoundary: Machine-owned runtime and launcher only. Provider credentials/subscriptions, Pi settings, project trust, project packages/extensions, sessions, models, and user preferences remain user/project scoped.
proofCeiling: Repository/static/CI proof can establish bootstrap parsing, exact tracked release identity, digest enforcement, ownership guards, and non-mutating Inspect behavior. A physical workstation Apply is required to prove Program Files mutation, Machine PATH convergence, launcher precedence, and usable Pi execution on that workstation.
